Cross-camera / cross-time links with a learned matcher (rgb.crosstime.matcher), 2026-09-26
============================================================================================
Bag rec_20260924_204902 (night), same 25 windows and protocol as tests/crosstime_eval_20260926.txt:
links from the "keys" solve (rgb/final_keys), final solve from zeroshot_pass2, halves A=windows[0::2] /
B=windows[1::2] from rgb/final, 1-sigma = |A-B|/sqrt(2); held-out = each half's calibration on the other
half (motion-only). Scripts: tests/crosstime_links.py, tests/crosstime_run_eval.sh, tests/crosstime_compare.py.

Method (rgb/lmatch.py, rgb/crosstime.py verify_pairs): per candidate link one observation of each track (the
0.5 s grid frames with the most similar viewing rays); both KLT points resampled into 160x160 virtual pinhole
crops (fisheye removed, world-vertical up, common metric scale >= 1.5 m, never finer than native); learned
matcher -> RANSAC homography -> local affine centre transfer (gross check <= 3 px, >= 6 local matches);
then sub-pixel NCC of the 21x21 centre template of A in B (NCC >= 0.8, offset <= 1.0 native px).

1. Matcher bake-off (candidate links of S03+W05, wide gate 0.1 m + 1 % depth, 4/8 px; stratified, all rear
   pairs; 1866 pairs; epi = share of matches within 2 px of the epipolar plane from the LO trajectory +
   calibration; verified = final rule; false-accept = same rule with crop B's centre moved 2 / 4 px;
   ms/pair = extract (2 crops) + match on the RTX 4060 Ti without other load (W05); GPU = peak allocated)

(* LighterGlue run pair by pair; ALIKED/SuperPoint/DISK LightGlue batched 16.)
- With the same decision rule all learned matchers verify the same links (0.15 of the wide candidates, 0.60
  of the geometrically tight ones) with the same false-accept rate; the sub-pixel precision comes from the
  rectification + NCC. NCC alone (no model) is statistically the same on these pairs. The learned gross check
  did not add measurable selectivity here.
- Controls: the same KLT track 1 s apart (true by construction): centre offset median 0.8 px front, 1.5 px
  side, 1.3 px rear (KLT drift + 10 m of view change) = the measurement floor.
- Rear: front<->rear candidates see the object from 85-115 deg apart (opposite faces): 0-2 % verify with any
  matcher; rear<->side / rear<->rear candidates are mostly 4-7 px apart in appearance (not the same point).
- Chosen for the full evaluation: xfeat_lighterglue (Apache-2.0 end to end, 167 MB GPU - the dev GPU was
  shared with another 5-6 GB job, ALIKED fell back to the CPU; lowest centre error on tight pairs).
  aliked_lightglue (best epipolar inlier ratio, BSD-3 + Apache-2.0) is the equivalent choice on the vehicle PC.

4. Runtime (dev box, RTX 4060 Ti shared with another job, HDD work folder)
Linking with xfeat_lighterglue over the wide candidates (559,707 pairs, 25 windows): ~5 min per window per
worker (JPEG decode + CLAHE ~45 %, LighterGlue pair by pair ~40 %, XFeat extraction ~4 %), 94 min wall with
two workers (~2.1 h single). The evaluated "loose" variant only needs the 211,738 geometry-ok pairs of the
default gates: ~0.8 h estimated single worker. BA: no extra cost (final 1294 s vs 1416 s without links).
Pipeline total with links on: + keys solve (~25 min) + linking (~0.8 h) (SIFT linking: 0.5-3 h).

5. Verdict
- Learned (rectified crop + NCC) verification removes most of the wrong merges: at the SIFT "loose" gates it
  halves the links (151,552 -> 77,252) and brings the track residual from 1.07 to 0.90 px, keeps the front
  rotation gain (0.017 vs 0.015 deg) and the rear position/axis gain (16.2 / 10.9 vs 17.9 / 10.3 mm), keeps
  about half of the front along-axis gain (4.6 vs 2.9 mm; none 7.6). Held-out unchanged, no >3-sigma shift.
- It does NOT reach the targets: track residual 0.90 px (target 0.84-0.86), side is not improved (worse than
  no links, as with SIFT), and rear links stay few (75; 255 with wide gates, which makes rear worse). Rear
  candidates are either opposite faces (front<->rear, 85-115 deg) or not the same point.
- Verified links still carry ~1 px of geometric residual (median, at the keys calibration) and raise the
  residual of unlinked observations too: the remaining inconsistency is in the model (per-camera time
  offset / rolling shutter / trajectory), not in the association. Next step if links are wanted: per-camera
  time offsets in the rig BA.
- Default stays off (rgb.crosstime.enabled: false, matcher: sift for the validated SIFT study). If links
  are enabled, use matcher: xfeat_lighterglue (or aliked_lightglue / ncc) with the default gates.
